Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

a and b together do a work in 20 days . b and c together in 15 days and c and a in 12 days . then b alone can finish same work in how many days ?

A. 50
B. 60
C. 45
D. 35
E. 48

message.content:
b's rate = ½(1/20 + 1/15 − 1/12) = ½(2/60) = 1/60, so b takes 60 days.

ANSWER: B
message.reasoning_content: Rates: a+b=1/20, b+c=1/15, c+a=1/12. Sum: a+b+c=(3+4+5)/60=12/60=1/5. c=1/5-1/20=3/20? wait c = total - (a+b) = 1/5-1/20=3/20. b = 1/5-1/12=7/60 → 60/7 ≈8.57, not an option. Hmm, standard answer: 60/7? Options don't match... maybe b alone = ? Actually common answer is 120/7? Recheck: b = (a+b)+(b+c)-(a+c) all over... b rate = (1/20+1/15-1/12)/2 = (3/60+4/60-5/60)/2=(2/60)/2=1/60 → 60 days. Answer B.

final_content:
b's rate = ½(1/20 + 1/15 − 1/12) = ½(2/60) = 1/60, so b takes 60 days.

ANSWER: B
